question: In which of the following years did Telangana become the 29th state of India after the reorganisation of the state of Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Telangana became the 29th state of India after the reorganisation of the state of Andhra Pradesh in 2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Telangana became the 29th state of India in 2014 by reorganizing Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
• Lok Sabha passed the Telangana bill on 18th February 2014.
 
• Rajya Sabha passed the Telangana bill on 20th February 2014.
 
• Telangana bill received the President's assent on 1st March 2014.
 
• Telangana was formed as the 29th state of India on 2nd June 2014.
 
 
 
• **Srikrishna Committee **was set up by the center to look into the need for a separate state of Telangana from Andhra Pradesh, and which had accorded the highest priority to a non-separation of the state. The committee was headed by former chief justice B. N. Srikrishna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Four icons of Telangana are:**

 
 
• State Bird - Palapitta (Indian Roller or Blue Jay)
 
• State Animal - Jinka (Deer)
 
• State Tree - Jammi Chettu (Prosopis Cineraria)
 
• State Flower - Tangedu (Tanner’s Cassia)
